title: dcposch/jc2-lean
abstract: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the vertex-gap obstruction at (k,d2) = (2,2) (label thm:22, Theorem 3.4 in the current compilation) from the campaign paper "A Vertex-Gap Obstruction for Low-Degree Strip Pairs in the Plane Jacobian Conjecture": for polynomials P, Q in K[x,y] over a field K of characteristic not in {2,3,5}, supported in the normalized type-(2,2) Newton strips along (1,2) with [P,Q] = x^2, the block coefficients satisfy a3 = 0 and a2^2*a6 = 0 - so the generic chart a2*a6 != 0 of the strip family is empty (VertexGap22, plus the side-symmetric companion VertexGap22_swapped in the mirrored labels). Also formalized: the arithmetic corner-enumeration lemma behind the vertex normalization (lem:enum, Lemma 2.2; CornerEnumeration) and the side-symmetric form of the gap condition, hypothesis (ii) as corrected by the erratum recorded in Section 8 (GapConditionSideSymm).  The theorem is the mechanism that empties the generic chart of the (8,28) strip subcase in the campaign on the plane Jacobian problem at Newton-degree pair (72,108).
